text:
alex: Heads up — PR #9427 (kv-cache hotpatch) needs 2 approvals before today's 12:30 UTC cutover. Blocking on an approval from infra and a second reviewer. CI status: `unit ✅ / integration flaky (retry)`.

mira: I can take infra review in ~20m. quick q: does this change the eviction policy? if no, i'm fine.

alex: thanks! no eviction behavior change, just a small path fix + metrics. repro in local is flaky but CI rerun clears it.

sam: i'll do a code review now. low risk but can you add a one-line changelog? makes audits easier.

alex: adding changelog now, pushing in 2.

release-bot: Reminder: cutover window at 12:30 UTC. PR must be merged and `cutoff=true` label applied before +1200s slack.

jordan: can we delegate second approval if original reviewer can't make it before cutoff? who is on the backup list?

mira: +1 to delegation. @sam you're backup for release owners. if sam approves and ci is green, we can merge.

sam: I pulled, small nit in comment, fixed in `alex/changelog-fix` branch. LGTM after CI passes.

ci-bot: Integration job retried by alex — all checks green (unit: 123s, integration: 420s)

alex: merging now. tagging with `cutoff=true`. thanks everyone :rocket: 

mira: great. pinging oncall to monitor for 15m.

oncall-bot: @oncall: watchlist added for 15 minutes for service kv-cache.

jordan: if any post-cutover issue, we'll autobackout to previous deploy. rollback playbook link: https://redwood.internal/rollback

sam: congrats. nice fast handoff :tada: 

alex: merged at 12:18 UTC. closing the loop.
